segments.name: Sporting Goods (Escalade Sports)
segments.description: Manufactures, imports, and distributes sporting goods brands in basketball goals, archery, indoor and outdoor game recreation and fitness products for retailers and consumers.
segments.evidence: Escalade, Incorporated (Escalade, the Company, we, us or our) operates in one business segment: Sporting Goods (Escalade Sports).

revenueModel.text: The company sells sporting goods products to major sporting goods retailers, specialty dealers, online retailers, direct-to-consumer e-commerce, department stores and mass merchants, primarily via standard purchase orders.
revenueModel.evidence: Sales are based primarily on standard purchase orders and in most cases, orders are shipped within the same month received.
